records.jp: これだね。<CR>よし、見るしかないか……
records.en_original: This is it. Right, let's get this over with...
records.en_auxiliary: This is it. Right, let's get this over with...
records.en: This is it.<CR>All right, I have no choice but to watch...

records.jp: （さすが日菜子さん。ためらう素振りなし。<CR>肝が据わってるな……）
records.en_original: (That's our Hinako. No hesitation whatsoever. She's so brave...)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's our Hinako. No hesitation whatsoever. She's so brave...)
records.en: (As expected of Hinako-san. Not a hint of hesitation.<CR>She has nerves of steel...)

records.jp: どうしよう。<CR>他に歌える曲は……
records.en_original: Hmm, what to do... What other songs can I sing...?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, what to do... What other songs can I sing...?
records.en: What should I do?<CR>Are there any other songs I can sing...?

records.jp: はい、次はヒナちゃんの番
records.en_original: All right, next up is Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: All right, next up is Hina!
records.en: All right, next up is Hina-chan!

records.jp: え、もう？
records.en_original: Already?!
records.en_auxiliary: Already?!
records.en: Already?!

records.jp: こ、ここでやめとかない？
records.en_original: Ahaha, let's, uh, let's stop here!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, let's, uh, let's stop here!
records.en: W-why do we not stop here?

records.jp: （全然据わってなかった）
records.en_original: (Guess she wasn't so brave after all.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Guess she wasn't so brave after all.)
records.en: (Guess she wasn't so brave after all.)

records.jp: なんでよ。こっからでしょ
records.en_original: Huh, why? We're just getting to the good part!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, why? We're just getting to the good part!
records.en: Huh, why? We're just getting to the good part!

records.jp: お願い！　本当にお願い！
records.en_original: Please! Please stop!
records.en_auxiliary: Please! Please stop!
records.en: Please! Please stop!

records.jp: （さっきの潔さはどこ行った）
records.en_original: (Where did all her cool resolve go?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Where did all her cool resolve go?)
records.en: (Where did all her cool resolve go?)

records.jp: これはユズさんたちとカラオケに行った時の<CR>記憶でしょうか？
records.en_original: Is this a memory from when you went to karaoke with Yuzu 	and Lime?
records.en_auxiliary: Is this a memory from when you went to karaoke with Yuzu 	and Lime?
records.en: Is this a memory from when you went to karaoke<CR>with Yuzu-san and the others?

records.jp: そう……途中で歌える曲がなくなっちゃったんだよね
records.en_original: Yeah... I ran out of songs I could sing.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... I ran out of songs I could sing.
records.en: Yeah... I ran out of songs I could sing.

records.jp: 二人に歌わせとけばいいのに
records.en_original: Why didn't you let one of them sing instead?
records.en_auxiliary: Why didn't you let one of them sing instead?
records.en: Why didn't you let one of them sing instead?

records.jp: マイクが回ってきたのに歌わなかったら、部屋に<CR>鍵がかかって一生閉じ込められるって聞いて
records.en_original: I heard that if the mic is passed to you and you don't sing, you'll be trapped inside the karaoke booth forever...
records.en_auxiliary: I heard that if the mic is passed to you and you don't sing, you'll be trapped inside the karaoke booth forever...
records.en: I heard that if the microphone reaches you and you do not sing,<CR>the room locks and traps you inside forever.

records.jp: どんなルールよそれ
records.en_original: What kind of rule is that?!
records.en_auxiliary: What kind of rule is that?!
records.en: What kind of rule is that?!

records.jp: あのさ、ここから先、みんな耳を塞いでくれたり<CR>……しないよね？
records.en_original: Um, so how about we all put our hands over our ears for the next bit...? No?
records.en_auxiliary: Um, so how about we all put our hands over our ears for the next bit...? No?
records.en: Hey, from this point on, could everyone cover their ears<CR>or... I suppose not?

records.jp: しません
records.en_original: Not happening.
records.en_auxiliary: Not happening.
records.en: Not happening.

records.jp: （あ、そうだ。あれを歌えばいいんだ）
records.en_original: (Oh, I know! There's that one song...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh, I know! There's that one song...)
records.en: (Oh, I know! There's that one song...)

records.jp: すぅ……
records.en_original: Okay...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay...
records.en: Okay...

records.jp: ちょうちょ　ちょうちょ<CR>なのはにとまれ
records.en_original: Butterfly, butterfly, stop along the flowerbed...
records.en_auxiliary: Butterfly, butterfly, stop along the flowerbed...
records.en: Butterfly, butterfly,<CR>rest upon the rapeseed flower.

records.jp: えっ
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: なのはにあいたら　さくらにとまれ
records.en_original: When you've gotten bored of flowers, stop along the cherry trees...
records.en_auxiliary: When you've gotten bored of flowers, stop along the cherry trees...
records.en: When you tire of the rapeseed flower, rest upon the cherry blossom.

records.jp: あ、あれか。<CR>あえて童謡を歌うっていうボケ……
records.en_original: Ah, I see. She's singing a nursery rhyme as a joke...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, I see. She's singing a nursery rhyme as a joke...
records.en: Ah, I see.<CR>She is deliberately singing a nursery rhyme as a joke...

records.jp: ヒナちゃんはそういう子じゃないでしょ
records.en_original: I don't know if Hina is the type for that...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know if Hina is the type for that...
records.en: I don't know if Hina-chan is the type for that...

records.jp: ってことは、本気の選曲……
records.en_original: So she...she seriously wanted to sing this song...?
records.en_auxiliary: So she...she seriously wanted to sing this song...?
records.en: So she...she seriously wanted to sing this song...?

records.jp: い、いいじゃん！<CR>何歌ったって！
records.en_original: I-I can sing what I want! It's a free country!
records.en_auxiliary: I-I can sing what I want! It's a free country!
records.en: I-it is fine!<CR>I can sing whatever I want!

records.jp: うん、確かにその通りなんだけど
records.en_original: Yeah, you certainly proved that.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you certainly proved that.
records.en: Yes, that is certainly true, but...

records.jp: うちらの年代の子が童謡をガチで歌ってると……<CR>こう、迫力があるといいますか
records.en_original: A girl our age singing nursery rhymes at karaoke? It's definitely, uh, impressive.
records.en_auxiliary: A girl our age singing nursery rhymes at karaoke? It's definitely, uh, impressive.
records.en: When a girl our age sings a nursery rhyme completely seriously...<CR>It has a certain intensity, shall we say.

records.jp: だいぶオブラートに包んだね
records.en_original: That's a nice way to put it.
records.en_auxiliary: That's a nice way to put it.
records.en: That's a nice way to put it.

records.jp: その時は歌える曲が少なかったんだよ！<CR>これくらいしか残ってなかったの！
records.en_original: I didn't know that many songs back then! That was all I had!
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't know that many songs back then! That was all I had!
records.en: I did not know many songs back then!<CR>This was about the only one I had left!

records.jp: 今はもっと色んな曲知ってるから！<CR>大丈夫だから！　ね！
records.en_original: I know WAY more songs now, so it'll never happen again! Got it?!
records.en_auxiliary: I know WAY more songs now, so it'll never happen again! Got it?!
records.en: I know many more songs now!<CR>So it is fine! All right?!

records.jp: （まぁ、童謡を歌う日菜子さんも<CR>かわいいっちゃかわいい……かな？）
records.en_original: (I dunno, I thought nursery song-singing Hinako was...kinda cute?)
records.en_auxiliary: (I dunno, I thought nursery song-singing Hinako was...kinda cute?)
records.en: (Well, Hinako-san singing a nursery rhyme<CR>was kind of cute... maybe?)
